files.description: The repo's operating contract: two-catalog system, build pipeline, validator + kernel-SSoT posture, do-not-flip soak discipline, required SKILL.md frontmatter, and the canonical identifiers that must never be renamed.
Session protocol — post-compaction recovery, end-of-session push checklist, beads workflow.
The NON-NEGOTIABLES: the 8-field ALWAYS_REQUIRED set, marketplace-tier error-vs-warning semantics, and which changes are approval-gated.
The authoritative prose-spec validator — the canonical merge gate for frontmatter and markdown body sections, plus the kernel-strict agent gate.
The unfiltered required aggregate: plugin structure, catalog invariants, README-TOC sync, and the lint/test matrix.
The marketplace design constitution — OKLCH-only colors, the Data-Dense Pro family, and explicitly rejected UI patterns.
The IS enterprise / marketplace skills standard (v3.x) that the validator enforces.
Operator contract for the advisory pull_request_target pre-screen, including base-authored execution and deterministic-verdict boundaries.
Field-level prose-validator to kernel authoring/v1 mapping, intentional deviations, and shadow-only migration posture.
Locked mirror-by-default, upstream-improvements, never-clobber authority model for externally synced plugins.
Supply-chain threat model for synced instructions, scripts, hooks, MCP servers, lock/quarantine, and REFUSE/CHALLENGE/FLAG semantics.
Human vetting and approval procedure that complements deterministic sync and scanner gates.
Issue-before-PR and tiered PRD/ADR/ONE-PAGER proof requirements for new authored plugins.
Repository security policy and disclosure boundary for plugin supply-chain findings.
External source registry; use it to evaluate verified/curated semantics, anchored include breadth, target ownership, and provenance.
Freshie SQLite runtime, one-way Dolt history, exporter, proof tables, and restore/operating contract.
Published package version, tag, release, and automated publish contract.
